summary: iter451 Phase 2 Store Search — thorough E2E backend + frontend verification. Backend: existing 6 unit tests + 18 new live-URL tests (24 total) all pass — endpoint shape, section-name hits, per-maker scoping (cross-maker leakage impossible), empty q, special-regex q (wood (oak), a+b, .*, [abc], hello?, x|y), long q truncation to 80, unknown-maker slug, zero-result suggestions capped at 5, scoring descending, limit default=12/max=24, popular-search meta reflects logged queries with results and excludes zero-result queries, per-maker meta isolation. Frontend on preview URL: input visible with correct combobox/aria-expanded/aria-autocomplete=list; typing 'wall' opens dropdown with store-search-section-wall-art (Wall Art · 3 products) at top; typing 'oak' returns 2 products with 1 <mark> highlight (only 'Carved Oak Wedding Monogram' has 'oak' in the title — 'Rustic Family Name Sign' matches on tags so its title correctly has no mark); Escape closes; nonsense query shows zero-result suggestion rows on iron-and-oak (has sections) AND correctly shows store-search-empty panel on metalart-pro (no sections) — perfect branching; store-search-by-section container renders when hits span multiple sections (broad 'a' query showed 2 chips); clicking product navigates to /shop/rustic-family-name-sign staying within storefront; localStorage cm_store_recent_iron-and-oak persisted ["sign"] after click; refocusing empty input surfaces store-search-recent-sign row and popular row from meta endpoint; clicking outside dropdown closes it; clicking section-hit row navigates to /makers/iron-and-oak/wall-art (Phase 1 deep link still works); mobile 390x844 dropdown fits within viewport (x=16, w=358) and is not clipped; no console errors originating from StoreSearch — the only 2 errors observed are unrelated ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (mocked google-ads endpoint per PRD). Screenshots captured for user: /app/test_reports/iter114_desktop_search.jpg (desktop 'oak' with highlighted mark) and /app/test_reports/iter114_mobile_search.jpg (mobile 'oak' with 2 product hits). Phase 2 Store Search is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: store_search.py L118 `total = len(scored)`: results-count logged to store_search_logs is products-only. A query that returns ONLY section hits (e.g. 'wall' on iron-and-oak → wall-art section with 3 products but no product title contains 'wall') logs results=0, so it's excluded from popular searches even though it's a legitimately useful result. Consider `total = len(scored) + len(section_hits)` OR log a separate `section_hits` field that meta also counts. Non-blocking but reduces the value of the popular-search rail for section-heavy stores.

store_search.py L60 `q = _norm(q).lower()`: lowercased once, then used in `title.lower() == q` (line 44) which is correct, but for regex `re.escape(q)` (already lowercased) with `re.IGNORECASE` flag — the IGNORECASE flag is redundant since q is lowercased AND then `.search(title)` in _score uses IGNORECASE too, so effectively double-lowercasing. Functionally correct, just a minor perf micro-opt.

StoreSearch.jsx L131 input padding `py-2.5` combined with the fixed h-8/w-8 image thumbnails at L173 look great at desktop; at mobile 390px, dropdown fits within viewport (verified box x=16, w=358 out of 390). Good.

StoreSearch.jsx L92-107 `go()` function: when clicking a product row, `pushRecent` uses `q.trim().toLowerCase()` — the current search term — not the product title. When clicking a section/suggestion row, it uses `row.name.toLowerCase()`. Verified: after clicking 'Rustic Family Name Sign' from a 'sign' search, localStorage stored ['sign'] (the query, not the product title). This is the expected UX pattern (Etsy/Amazon behavior) so it's fine — just calling out for main agent awareness.

StoreSearch.jsx L109-115 `onKey`: handler only runs `if (!open) return` — so ArrowDown while dropdown is closed does nothing. If the user tabs into the input and presses ArrowDown while the dropdown just closed, they can't reopen with keyboard. Minor a11y gap; typing any character re-opens it via setOpen(true) so real users are unaffected.

StoreSearch.jsx L57-60 outside-click listener: `mousedown` on document — works but doesn't handle touch events explicitly. On mobile Safari, `mousedown` is synthesized from touch so it still works (verified on mobile 390px viewport). Non-blocking.

store_search.py L124-129 fire-and-forget insert: uses `await` inside `try/except Exception: pass` — if Mongo is slow this still blocks the response. A true fire-and-forget would `asyncio.create_task(...)`. Non-blocking; current implementation still returns quickly in normal operation.
Highlight component L26-37: single-occurrence highlight only (first match). If the query appears twice in a title, only the first is marked. Acceptable for search relevance UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 checklist items: input+combobox aria, debounced live search, section hit ranking, product hits with highlighted <mark>, keyboard nav ArrowDown/Up/Enter/Escape, zero-result suggestions branching (with/without sections), by_section jump chips, product→/shop nav, section→/makers/{slug}/{section} nav, recent (localStorage per-store), popular from meta, click-outside close, mobile 390px viewport fit, deep-link regression, no StoreSearch console errors)
